name: Game moneyline (team win probability)
hyp: Team strength model gives a probability; compared with a no-vig market price.

name: Point spread / margin
hyp: Expected margin model; compare with a priced line.
inputs: Historical box scores (restricted, F-01); licensed odds (none).

name: Game total points
hyp: Pace and efficiency model for total points.

name: Player points over/under
hyp: Player scoring distribution given expected minutes.
inputs: Game logs (restricted, F-04); minutes forecast (none, F-05); prop prices (none).

name: Player rebounds / assists over/under
hyp: As ST-04 for rebounds and assists.

name: Same-game parlay (team side + player prop)
hyp: Joint probability from a fitted dependence model, not the product of legs.

name: Cross-game 2-leg parlay
hyp: Independence assumed as a hypothesis to test, not as a fact.

name: Injury-adjusted rotation (minutes redistribution)
hyp: When a player is out, minutes move to listed teammates.

name: Injury-adjusted team production
hyp: Team scoring and efficiency change with the rotation.

name: Rest and schedule density
hyp: Back-to-back and short-rest effects on performance.
inputs: Schedule dates (verified: S05); venue distances (none verified); results (restricted).

name: No-vig market consensus (benchmark, not a strategy)
hyp: Used as the baseline all strategies must beat.
